title: GDC / ICGC open-tier metadata adapter
context: An adapter that transforms GDC/ICGC open-tier public metadata (cases/files metadata) into a valid canonical record, for the pinned API version recorded in specVersions. The open-tier scoping is sensitive, so the Gate reviewer confirms the adapter never touches controlled-access endpoints (hence riskTier medium). Golden captured-response fixtures are diffed in CI. No partner is yet secured, so verifiedNeed is false and requestor is TO BE SECURED.
objective: Deliver a GDC/ICGC open-tier metadata adapter that emits valid canonical records from open-tier public metadata, Gate-confirmed for scoping, with golden fixtures and CI, as a PR.
acceptanceCriteria: Transforms the source's public metadata response into a valid canonical record for the pinned API version (recorded in specVersions): GDC/ICGC open-tier cases/files metadata.
Ships committed golden captured public-metadata response -> expected canonical record fixtures, diffed in CI; output validated against the canonical-model schema.
Open tier only: the adapter never requests authenticated/controlled-access endpoints; the Gate reviewer confirms the open-tier scoping.
Code MIT-licensed; unit tests + CI green; no credentials embedded; no individual-level data in fixtures.
